stations.title: Rhiannon
stations.say: What does a 125 metre plot cost?
stations.note: Asked at the gate every week.

stations.title: The envelope
stations.text: She works out each fee by hand.

stations.title: Terminal
stations.text: One line with the fee, and exit code 0.

captions: At Marrowfield allotments, Rhiannon is asked what a plot of 125 square metres costs.
She works it out on the back of an envelope, every time someone asks.
You write two small scripts that read what she types, in four tasks.
Now the laptop prints the fee for a size she types, and a bad size gets a plain error.
Same question at the gate, no envelope. The laptop answers in one line.
